query: 查询2025年北京市7月的销售额
sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.pay_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order AS fo
LEFT JOIN dim_store AS ds
    ON fo.store_id = ds.store_id
WHERE fo.order_status = '已完成'
    AND ds.city = '北京'
    AND fo.pay_time >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND fo.pay_time < '2025-08-01 00:00:00'

query: 查询2025年华北大区7月的销售额
sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.pay_amount) AS `销售额`
FROM fact_order AS fo
LEFT JOIN dim_store AS ds ON fo.store_id = ds.store_id
WHERE fo.order_status = '已完成'
  AND ds.region = '华北'
  AND fo.pay_time >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND fo.pay_time < '2025-08-01 00:00:00'

query: 查询2025年北京王府井旗舰店7月的销售额
sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.pay_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order AS fo
LEFT JOIN dim_store AS ds ON fo.store_id = ds.store_id
WHERE ds.store_name = '北京王府井旗舰店'
  AND fo.order_status = '已完成'
  AND fo.pay_time >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND fo.pay_time < '2025-08-01 00:00:00'

query: 查询2025年7月用户所在城市为北京市的销售额
sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.pay_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_user du ON fo.user_id = du.user_id
WHERE du.city = '北京'
  AND fo.order_status = '已完成'
  AND fo.pay_time >= '2025-07-01'
  AND fo.pay_time < '2025-08-01'
